rationale: The previous candidate performed excellently with no line loss events and very low oscillation, but the evaluator suggests further tuning to potentially improve oscillation and progress. I increased kd from 4 to 5 to add more damping and reduce any residual oscillations. I changed the line_loss strategy from 'search_left' to 'search_right' to test if an alternative recovery direction improves line reacquisition. I also increased base_speed slightly from 1.5 to 1.6 to improve pace and progress, as the previous run showed stable control at 1.5 speed. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they are already well optimized. I expect these changes to maintain or improve completion and progress, reduce oscillations further, and test if the alternative line loss strategy is beneficial. I request the same measurements as before to verify these effects.
